column1: # The phone/PC byte pin (HnsPinnedSeedsTest in app, KaizoCorePcPinTest in desktop): preset, pool, seed, the run's ROM
# SHA-1 and its log's SHA-1 (UTF-8). Both tests must read these exact lines. Made from the comfort build E61D7527.
# Pinned again 2026-10-07: Black 2 rules for Heart & Soul (Gen 1-5 moves on Nat. Dex, no HM move rolled, Black 2's
# abilities, evolutions sharing a type with the Pokemon evolving, Nat. Dex BST line 601).
# Pinned again 2026-10-11 on comfort build AA092306 (patches 0001-0058). They had last been written on E61D7527;
# the builds after it (CDC719C2, Nat. Dex Emerald's Gen 3 rules; 1C824440; AA092306) each moved the bytes on
# purpose, and the pins were left behind. Printed by HnsPinnedSeedsTest (IRONMON_PIN_PRINT=1); the PC test
# Pinned again 2026-10-11 for fix4: trainer levels ease off above base level 50 (HnsRandomizer.trainerLevel), so only
# Red's strongest reaches 100. Every seed moved, as it should: every Kaizo game has trainers above base 50.
# Pinned again 2026-10-11 for fix6 on comfort build F4E28E3D (patches 0001-0060: Whirlpool, Red without Hail).
# 2026-10-23 (patch 0061): two builds of one game. Columns 4-5 are KaizoCore PC's build F4E28E3D (unchanged), 6-7 the
# Android app's build F5F37A8E: the same run, with its ROM tables at other offsets (its ROM bytes and the offsets its log
# names). HnsPinnedSeedsTest checks the app's columns, KaizoCorePcPinTest the PC's and both logs alike without offsets.
